result.question: Quais municípios com mais de 500 internações aparecem simultaneamente no top-20 de volume e no top-20 de taxa de mortalidade nos estados MA e RS?
result.gold_sql: WITH top_volume AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20), top_mortalidade AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT tv.nome FROM top_volume tv WHERE tv.nome IN (SELECT nome FROM top_mortalidade) ORDER BY tv.nome;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ), taxa_mortalidade AS ( SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome ), top_internacoes AS ( SELECT municipio, total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rn FROM total_internacoes ), top_taxa AS ( SELECT municipio, taxa, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY taxa DESC) AS rn FROM taxa_mortalidade ) SELECT ti.municipio, ti.total, tt.taxa FROM top_internacoes ti JOIN top_taxa tt ON ti.municipio = tt.municipio WHERE ti.rn <= 20 AND tt.rn <= 20;
